mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising FEDFUNDS, or returns are positive despite increasing FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index crosses above 205, indicating elevated inflationary pressures, investors anticipate higher interest rates, leading to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 205, or returns are positive during such crossings.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in economic demand (GDPC1) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable environment for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >5% and FEDFUNDS falls >0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 rises >5% and FEDFUNDS falls >0.5%, or the combination does not occur during positive return periods.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market activity (PAYEMS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS >1.4M and UNRATE <4.0%, or the combination does not occur during positive return periods.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the INDPRO index above 113.5 signals increased supply-side activity, which may reduce inflationary pressures and support equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 113.5, or returns are positive during such crossings.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in labor market employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising PAYEMS, or returns are negative despite increasing PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market expansion regime, low unemployment rates (UNRATE below 3.5%) and elevated labor demand (PAYEMS above 1.3 million) create conditions for sustained economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE <3.5% and PAYEMS >1.3M, or the combination does not occur during positive return periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS <4.5%), a surge in economic demand (GDPC1 >11500) creates a favorable balance between low borrowing costs and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS <4.5% and GDPC1 >11500, or the combination does not occur during positive return periods.
